$description: BuidlGuidl Devcon 8 slide kit. Every colour, font, type style, radius, margin and mark size the kit uses, each with its use. The build reads this file and nothing else holds a value: build/tokens.py writes design/tokens.css and design/style-sheet.html from it, and build/backgrounds.py, build/logos.sh and build/build_pptx.py read it directly.

ink.$description: all text on light grounds, arrows, the dark ground

paper.$description: text on the dark ground, cards

ground.$description: the content ground, from buidlguidl.com; already baked into content.png

periwinkle.$description: bullets, the quote bar, number pills

periwinkle-light.$description: prompt glyphs and labels on the dark ground

lime.$description: the highlight marker, always with ink text; the lime button on buidlguidl.com

sky-top.$description: top of the cover gradient, from the buidlguidl.com hero; baked into cover.png

sky-bottom.$description: bottom of the cover gradient; baked into cover.png

sans.$description: headings, body, labels. SIL Open Font License, in fonts/space-grotesk

mono.$description: code, tags, handles. SIL Open Font License, in fonts/space-mono

medium.$description: body medium and labels. pptx has no 500, see the pptxBold flag on each type style

type.$description: Sizes are px on the 1920x1080 canvas; lineHeight is a multiple of the size. The px line height the pptx uses is round(size x lineHeight). Letter-spacing is 0 everywhere.

cover-title.$description: title, closing, up next: two lines in a 1150 wide box above the art

cover-title-long.$description: a cover title that needs three lines, so it stays in the box and clear of the wordmark

body.$description: everything the audience must read; nothing readable goes smaller

body-medium.$description: speaker name, card titles, diagram box text, quote author

label.$description: credits, part numbers, pill numbers, captions under diagram boxes. Never for a point you are making

tag.$description: the corner tags, the event line, handles, time and room on cover slides, code identifiers in captions

panel.$description: cards, the image panel, diagram boxes

image.$description: an image inside a panel, a post screenshot

height.$description: with width, the 16:9 canvas every position is measured on; 10 x 5.625 in as a pptx

margin-x.$description: left and right margin; nothing readable sits outside it

margin-y.$description: top and bottom margin; the marks sit inside the top band

mark.$description: The BuidlGuidl marks baked into the backgrounds. The wordmark sits at the margin corner of cover.png and section.png; the castle and the Devcon 8 tag sit in the top margin band of content.png and content-dark.png, castle at the left margin and tag ending at the right margin.

castle-height.$description: also the line box of the Devcon 8 tag, so both centre on the same line

band-top.$description: top edge of the castle and the tag: centred on the middle of the top margin band

highlight.$description: The lime marker behind a highlighted phrase, in em of the text it sits behind.

overhang.$description: how far the marker extends past the words on each side

pad-y.$description: marker above and below the text
